Well-executed experiments with clear methodology: 5 random seeds, multiple proxy datasets, computational cost analysis showing efficiency over MC-Dropout

Critical gap between theory and practice: Definition 3.1 formally defines epistemic uncertainty via parameter posterior covariance, but the method simply computes -log p(z), bypassing the entire Bayesian framework the theory motivates

Requires representative proxy dataset as fundamental requirement; performance degrades with domain gaps (acknowledged for CIFAR-100); fairness concern about underrepresented demographics is mentioned but not empirically investigated

weaknesses: Critical theoretical gaps: Key assumptions (local linearity of encoder, dynamical isometry, first-order optimality connection to proxy data) are not empirically validated; the chain of reasoning linking parameter posteriors → Jacobian norms → data density → embedding density has logical jumps

Limited methodological novelty: Applies existing Riemannian Flow Matching (Chen & Lipman 2024) with straightforward conditional extension; main contribution is application rather than methodological innovation

Comprehensive experimental validation including systematic ablation studies (Riemannian vs Euclidean, proxy data size, ODE integration steps) with proper statistical reporting and multiple proxy datasets
Excellent presentation and reproducibility with complete mathematical derivations, detailed hyperparameters, architectural specifications, training algorithms, and honest limitations discussion

strengths: Addresses a genuine problem in VLM uncertainty quantification with clear motivation
Technically sound application of Riemannian Flow Matching respecting manifold geometry; ablations confirm 3-5% benefits from geometric awareness
Comprehensive experimental evaluation across 6 benchmarks, 3 proxy datasets, multiple baselines with proper controls and sensitivity analyses
Honest discussion of limitations including fairness concerns, theoretical gaps, and architectural scope boundaries
Good reproducibility: detailed hyperparameters, architectural specs, multiple random seeds, and promised code release
weaknesses: Theoretical motivation critically weak: (A1) uses unvalidated local approximation; (A2) is expectation-level only with no pointwise guarantee; (A3) explicitly acknowledged as open problem. Core argument rests on unproven assumptions rather than formal derivation

Modest empirical improvements with strong simple baselines: W-CLIP and Embedding Norm achieve comparable performance despite far greater simplicity (Embedding Norm matches REPVLM on Food101); typical improvements are 2-3% when REPVLM wins; Spearman S=1.0 plateau is uninformative about calibration

Severely limited architectural scope: SigLIP results (Table 11) show significant degradation on in-distribution benchmarks with negative Spearman correlations, contradicting core assumption (A3) that p(z)∝p(x); claims are effectively limited to CLIP-style cosine-similarity models

Significant practical barriers: requires large representative proxy dataset (not truly post-hoc), access to large-scale image-caption data, and A100 GPUs; for specialized domains finding appropriate proxies is non-trivial

Fundamental unresolved fairness problem: method conflates rarity with ignorance, systematically flagging valid underrepresented-group examples as outliers in data curation; proposed human-review solution undermines automation and is not principled solution

Missing critical analyses: no calibration metrics (ECE, Brier score), no per-subgroup fairness audits, no sensitivity analysis to proxy dataset quality or noise, no investigation of why only 5 ODE steps suffice (suggests problem simpler than presented)

Overclaimed contributions: 'Theoretical Motivation' provides only empirical heuristics; applying existing RFM to known manifold is methodological not conceptual contribution; density-based UQ is not novel (W-CLIP, Conformity, Embedding Norm pre-exist)
SigLIP failure relegated to appendix despite contradicting core theory: should be prominent in main paper to properly scope claims and manage reader expectations about applicability

Comprehensive experimental evaluation across 6 benchmarks, 3 proxy datasets, multiple backbones, with thorough ablations and applications (OOD detection, data curation)
